title: Care Management Bulletin: Hospital-Stay Credit on Transition-of-Care Units
content:
**Rule.** The hospital-stay credit of a transition-of-care request looks at the member's paid inpatient stay claims with service dates in the three months before the day the request is recorded and at the care-transition follow-ups the care team recorded in the two months before that day (a date counts when fewer whole months than stated separate it from that day): where at least one such inpatient stay and at least one such follow-up are on file, the credit is one full week of the class's weekly frequency cap; where at least one such inpatient stay is on file but no such follow-up, the credit is the earlier approval's weekly pace, which is the units posted as used on it divided by its whole weeks (its days from start date through end date counted inclusively, divided by seven and rounded down, never fewer than one), rounded down to a whole unit; where no such inpatient stay is on file, there is no hospital-stay credit.

The credit is added once to the units a Prior Authorization transition-of-care request asks for, before the ceiling of the class's most units per approval is applied.

## Records the credit reads

- **Inpatient stays:** claims on the member's Medicaid Managed Care Membership claim ledger whose service category is an inpatient stay and whose adjudication status is paid, with a service date inside the three-month window.
- **Follow-ups:** care-transition follow-ups recorded by the member's Care Management care team, dated inside the two-month window.
- **Weekly pace:** the units posted as used on the earlier Prairie Ridge approval, and that approval's start and end dates.

## Decision table

| Paid inpatient stay, last 3 months | Care-transition follow-up, last 2 months | Credit |
|---|---|---|
| at least 1 | at least 1 | one full week of the class's weekly frequency cap |
| at least 1 | none | the earlier approval's weekly pace, rounded down |
| none | at least 1 | no credit |
| none | none | no credit |

## Illustrations (hypothetical)

- *Window edge:* a request recorded on a hypothetical 15 June. An inpatient stay with service date 16 March counts, because fewer than three whole months separate it from 15 June; one dated 15 March does not, because three whole months separate them.
- *Weekly pace:* a hypothetical earlier approval ran 1 March through 29 May, 90 days counted inclusively; 90 divided by seven is 12.86, rounded down to 12 whole weeks. With 30 units posted as used, 30 divided by 12 is 2.5, rounded down to a credit of 2 units.
- *Short approval:* a hypothetical approval of 5 days has no whole week, so one week is used; with 3 units used the pace is 3.
- *Full week:* in a hypothetical class whose weekly frequency cap is 3, a stay plus a follow-up gives a credit of 3 units.
